'''Dreadnoth the Jellied''' is a boss in [[The Fractured Archive]] raid. He is a powerful [[Demons|demon]] that a group of [[Zamorak]]ian mages attempted to summon inside the Archive, but the ritual was performed incorrectly, and he was only able to partially make it into [[Gielinor]]. Before his corporeal form disintegrated back to [[Infernus]], he turned the mages into a jelly, encasing himself in them.

During a given raid of The Fractured Archive, players can choose to fight either Dreadnoth or [[Moia]] as the third boss encounter.
